page_title: PAL 2-3 MAL | Las Palmas v Mallorca 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Alejandro Ruiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) gets booked.
90+2' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is cautioned by the referee.
90+1' 2 - 3 Johan Mojica (Mallorca) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the left side of the goal.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Sandro Ramirez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has earned a red card!
88' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) gets a yellow card.
86' Substitution. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will be replaced by Chiquinho.
86' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Valery replacing Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
84' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Dominik Greif no chance!
83' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
82' That looked a certain handball by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
77' 1 - 2 Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
76' That will be all from Robert Navarro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
76' It's time for a substitution. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) comes on in place of Kirian Rodriguez.
71' The substitution has been made. Jose Copete (Mallorca) has replaced Antonio Raillo.
71' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
68' A yellow card for a tackle by Antonio Raillo (Mallorca). Alejandro Ruiz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' It's a yellow card for Dario Essugo (Las Palmas).
61' A substitution has been made. Alex Munoz goes off and Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes on.
61' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Jose Campana is replaced by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
61' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Substitution. Manuel Fuster did his best and is replaced by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
56' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Johan Mojica tees up Robert Navarro (Mallorca) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Jasper Cillessen.
54' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
50' A clumsy foul by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle.
49' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' 0 - 1 Goal! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 0:1.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
43' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) has received a yellow card for his foul.
43' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
41' Viti (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
38' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
34' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
29' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Las Palmas.
28' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
27' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

26' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
25' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
21' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
19' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Viti (Las Palmas) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
16' Viti (Las Palmas) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Ruiz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
13' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
13' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Mallorca have a corner.
9' Alejandro Ruiz blows the whistle, Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) is penalised for a foul.
8' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) commits a foul after dangerous play.
6' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
5' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
4' Viti (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Las Palmas get a corner.
3' A cross into the box from Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is cleared.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz was nominated as the referee for this game.
